Common questions

Do you clean oriental rugs?

Yes. We clean oriental and specialty rugs as well as everyday area rugs.

Can you get pet odors out of rugs?

We treat pet stains and odors in area rugs, and our products are safe for kids and pets once dry.

How much does a cleaning cost?

Every job is different, so pricing depends on the size, the number of rooms or pieces and their condition. Request a free quote and we’ll give you a clear price before any work starts.

How do I get a quote?

Send a request on our Request a Quote page or call 262-338-0783.
